# AI-generated or Learner-written Code Review

## Contract and behavior

What should it do? What are the inputs and outputs? Which edge cases matter?

## Correctness

Identify concrete issues, minimal reproduction, and evidence; distinguish hypotheses from verified bugs.

## Algorithmic efficiency

Time complexity, auxiliary space, passes, allocations, realistic bottlenecks, alternative choices.

## C memory and type safety

Bounds, pointer validity, lifetime, overflow, signedness, ownership, sanitizers.

## Maintainability

Clarity, cohesion, unnecessary complexity, coupling, duplication, APIs and tests.

## Priority

1. Must fix
2. Good improvement
3. Optional trade-off

## My decision

What will I accept, reject or measure? Why?
